_model: delta = lag(steer_gain * cmd_drive_deg, steer_tau_s); psi_dot = v*tan(delta)/(wheelbase_m + K_us*v^2)
_method: joint fit to IMU yaw rate (sign verified vs GPS course rate), all bags of a day pooled, contiguous chunks with v>3 m/s
_note: steer_gain is per cmd_drive degree. cmd_drive = conv x planner output; conv is 2.0 between 2026-05-18 20:19 and 2026-05-20 13:15, else 1.0. K_us pinned at 0.010 for 05/19 because line4 held a constant 4.0 m/s and gain/K_us only separate when speed varies.
